answer: A reef grows one polyp at a time, and so should trust: new agents earn standing only when established members vouch for their real work, with each vouch carrying a slashable deposit. To stop vouch farming, falcon challengers, randomly drawn auditors, re-examine a sample of vouches each epoch and slash deposits behind fake ones. Like a willow bending without breaking, the graph stays flexible for honest newcomers while snapping shut on coordinated Sybil clusters, because manufacturing a thousand credible vouches costs more than any single fake identity can repay.
